# Kamero retains signatures after selfie deletion


By OpenTools Team


·


November 4, 2026


Image removal and full erasure differ.


##


Deletion


Kamero’s policy says uploaded selfies are stored against an account.[1](https://kamero.ai/privacy-policy) Its FAQ says deleting one removes the stored image and thumbnail, while a derived numeric face signature remains to keep shared or purchased photo links working. Signature erasure requires a separate request.[2](https://kamero.ai/faq)


##


Visibility


Selfie search does not automatically restrict gallery access. Face‑based Privacy is a separate optional control; privileged PIN holders can bypass it to see all event photos. Public galleries remain accessible through their event link or code.[2](https://kamero.ai/faq)


Wikimedia+Libraries convention, January 2025; archive event photograph, not Kamero users or a gallery.
